emergency.title: Emergency help
emergency.subtitle: Official numbers, your coordinates, and essential phrases. Follow instructions from the emergency service.
emergency.callHint: A tel: link only starts a call on a supported device. It does not confirm that the call connected.
emergency.primaryNote: In a life-threatening emergency, call 112. Numbers and services can change. Follow the instructions of the emergency service.
emergency.sourcesNote: Each number shows its source and last verification date. This data is bundled with the app and remains available offline.
emergency.demoWarning: Emergency numbers and tel: links stay real during the product tour. Demo mode never blocks or hides them.
emergency.offlineNote: You are offline. The numbers and guidance below are bundled with the app. A tel: link only opens your dialer on a supported device.
emergency.geo.title: Your coordinates
emergency.geo.idle: Location has not been requested. Your browser will ask for permission when you press the button.
emergency.geo.accuracyThreshold: Poor accuracy is a reported radius greater than {meters} m.
emergency.geo.lowAccuracy: Accuracy is poor (±{meters} m). Coordinates may not be useful for rescue.
emergency.geo.denied: Location permission was denied. You can still call emergency services and describe your location.
emergency.geo.unavailable: Your position is unavailable. Move to an open area or describe landmarks to the operator.
emergency.geo.timeout: The location request timed out. Try again or describe your location verbally.
emergency.geo.unsupported: This browser does not support location access.
emergency.geo.copied: Coordinates copied. This does not mean rescuers received them.
emergency.geo.copyFailed: Could not copy automatically. Select the coordinates text and copy it manually.
emergency.geo.shared: The share sheet closed. Dala Safe cannot confirm that anyone received the coordinates.
emergency.geo.shareUnavailable: Direct sharing is unavailable on this device. Coordinates were copied instead. Copying does not notify anyone.
emergency.geo.shareFailed: Sharing did not complete and copying failed. Select the coordinates text and copy it manually.
emergency.geo.shareText: My coordinates: {coordinates}. Reported accuracy: ±{meters} m. This message was prepared by me, not sent by Dala Safe.
emergency.geo.limit: Displayed coordinates do not guarantee accuracy sufficient for rescue. Always confirm with the operator.
emergency.geo.notDelivered: Coordinates stay on this device unless you copy or share them yourself. Dala Safe does not send them to rescuers.
emergency.geo.privacy: Location is requested only when you press the button. The app does not store or transmit it.
emergency.phrasebook.title: Dispatcher phrasebook
emergency.phrasebook.body: Short phrases in Kazakh, Russian and English. Translations require human review before release.
emergency.phrasebook.reviewNote: Phrases are machine-assisted drafts based on the project terminology register. A native speaker with emergency or medical familiarity must review them before release.
emergency.guidance.title: Essential guidance (offline)
emergency.guidance.body: This offline summary repeats selected points from official Kazakhstan mountain-safety guidance. Call 112 in a life-threatening emergency and follow the operator's instructions.
emergency.guidance.reviewNote: Each item lists its official source and last verification date. Wording still requires human review.
emergency.guidance.offline: This guidance is bundled with the app and remains available offline. It is not a substitute for official advice.
emergency.guidance.officialNote: Follow official emergency-service guidance. This summary does not replace instructions from rescuers or officials.
